Žogarija: harmonija generacij je serija oddaj, ki skozi pristne zgodbe in pogovore povezuje otroke, starše in stare starše. Vsaka oddaja prikazuje medgeneracijsko sodelovanje, igre, ustvarjalnost in vrednote družine v središču lokalnega dogajanja. Gre za toplo, življenjsko serijo, ki spodbuja povezanost in aktivno skupnost.

programme.title: Report
programme.desc: Tedenska predstavitev vsebin iz lokalnega okolja. Voditeljica Špela Pokeržnik gosti športnike, glasbenike, politike in vodje društev. Napeta jesen: Po krizi v stranki SPÖ se vse bolj vsiljuje vprašanje: Kako stabilna je sploh še tripartitna vlada? Načrtuje reforme in je razglasila "jesen rezultatov" – pri tem pa naleti na številne ovire: na primer na vsebinska razhajanja med koalicijskimi partnerji ali zapletena pogajanja z zveznimi deželami ter nizko pripravljenost opozicije, da bi podprla reforme. Ali lahko reforme v takšnih razmerah uspejo – in to s krhko začasno rešitvijo na čelu SPÖ? Živčnost narašča, predvsem v zveznih deželah, ki so že v predvolilnem boju. Laura Franz in Diana Weidlinger o napeti jeseni za vlado. Gostoma v studiu: politologinja Katrin Praprotnik in predsednik fiskalnega sveta Christoph Badelt. Na robu zmogljivosti – bolezen v politiki: Ob finančnem ministru Markusu Marterbauerju se pravkar vname kočljiva razprava: Kaj storiti, ko vrhunski politik zboli? Kako transparentno je treba ravnati v takem primeru? Koliko zasebnosti je dovoljeno? Nekdanji zeleni minister za zdravje Johannes Rauch, ki je bil pred ministrskim položajem bolnik z rakom, javna ugibanja o Marterbauerjevem zdravstvenem stanju označuje za "nespoštljiva" in mu svetuje: "Pazi nase." Sam je svojo bolezen javno razkril šele leta pozneje, da bi odpravil tabuje in opogumil druge. Poslanec ÖVP in vodja pravosodnega odbora Klaus Fürlinger meni, da mora človek kot politik prenesti več kot pripadniki drugih poklicev. Zaradi kronične ohromitvene bolezni je vezan na invalidski voziček, vendar lahko s pomočjo glasovnega avatarja znova govori. O odstopu ni nikoli razmišljal. In pravi: "Politike ne moreš delati napol." Barbara Krivanek in Sabina Riedl iščeta odgovore na težko vprašanje, kako ravnati z boleznijo v politiki. Milijonska nesnaga: 59.000 ton starih pnevmatik leži, deloma že desetletja, sredi zgornjeavstrijske občine Ohlsdorf. In to kljub temu, da bi moralo biti skladišče pnevmatik po odločbi iz leta 2011 že zdavnaj izpraznjeno. Ker je zadevnemu podjetju, ki je desetletja dobro služilo s pnevmatikami, medtem zmanjkalo denarja za odstranitev, je dežela Zgornja Avstrija privolila, da pnevmatike za vedno ostanejo v naravi. In to kljub temu, da je v preteklosti že večkrat prišlo do okoljskih nesreč, kot sta onesnaženje pitne vode in samovžig pnevmatik. Patrick Gruska je obiskal kraj, ki se obupano bori, da bi se končno znebil preteklega okoljskega greha, in pri tem razkril, da je okoljski problem še bistveno večji, kot se je domnevalo doslej.

programme.title: Snooker : Open d'Irlande du Nord
programme.desc: L'Open d'Irlande du Nord 2026, faisant partie des Home Nations Series, se déroule au Waterfront Hall de Belfast, marquant la dixième édition de ce tournoi. Les meilleurs joueurs du circuit s'affrontent pour soulever le trophée Alex Higgins. Parmi eux, ce soir, pour le 1er tour : Ali Carter face à Xu Si, Neil Robertson contre Ricky Walden ou encore Shaun Murphy, opposé à Liam Davies.

programme.title: Cyclisme : Championnats du monde sur route
programme.desc: La course en ligne dames se déroule sur une distance de 180,4 km entre Brossard et Montréal, au Canada, pour un parcours exigeant totalisant environ 2500 m de dénivelé positif.

programme.title: Cyclisme : Championnats du monde sur route
programme.desc: Qui va revêtir le maillot arc-en-ciel et succéder au palmarès au Slovène Tadej Pogacar ? En l'absence de ce dernier, blessé lors du Tour d'Espagne, les favoris pour le titre sont les Belges Remco Evenepoel et Wout van Aert, et le Néerlandais Mathieu van der Poel. Mais une quinzaine de coureurs peuvent également rêver du maillot arc-en-ciel, à l'image du jeune prodige français Paul Seixas, de l'Equatorien Richard Carapaz ou encore de l'Espagnol Isaac Del Toro.

programme.title: Snooker : Open d'Irlande du Nord
programme.desc: Ce soir, c'est l'entrée en lice, dans le tournoi, de l'ancien numéro un mondial, l'Anglais Judd Trump. Il affronte son compatriote Martin O'Donnell (n°54). L'an dernier, Trump avait été battu en finale, à Belfast, par Jack Lisowski (9-8). A suivre également Stuart Bingham contre Yao Pengcheng, John Higgins face à Liam Highfield ou encore Zhang Anda, opposé à Liam Pullen.

A suivre également Stuart Bingham contre Yao Pengcheng, John Higgins face à Liam Highfield ou encore Zhang Anda, opposé à Liam Pullen.

programme.title: Cyclisme : Championnats du monde sur route
programme.desc: Qui va revêtir le maillot arc-en-ciel et succéder au palmarès au Slovène Tadej Pogacar ? En l'absence de ce dernier, blessé lors du Tour d'Espagne, les favoris pour le titre sont les Belges Remco Evenepoel et Wout van Aert, et le Néerlandais Mathieu van der Poel. Mais une quinzaine de coureurs peuvent également rêver du maillot arc-en-ciel, à l'image du jeune prodige français Paul Seixas, de l'Equatorien Richard Carapaz ou encore de l'Espagnol Isaac Del Toro.

programme.title: Equitation : Global Champions Tour
programme.desc: Diffusion d'étapes du Global Champions Tour, une compétition internationale de saut d'obstacles réservée aux trente meilleurs cavaliers du classement mondial. La crème du hippisme se réunit lors de ces compétitions de saut d'obstacles qui se déroulent sur les plus réputés terrains de concours hippiques au monde. Créé en 2005, le Global Champions Tour a intégré la FEI sous forme de compétition officielle depuis 2008.

programme.title: Athlétisme : Marathon d'Amsterdam

programme.title: ⋗ MLB Central
programme.desc: MLB Central (Sports). MLB Network's first-ever regular-season morning show features hosts Robert Flores, Mark DeRosa and Lauren Shehadi reporting from Studio 21, named in honor of Hall of Famer and humanitarian Roberto Clemente. Updates and context on the latest news, extensive on-field highlights, and long-form conversations with guests, celebrities and insiders from around baseball are presented each weekday morning. Flores joined the network in 2016 as a host/reporter, DeRosa offers a unique outlook as a former player, and Shehadi honed crisp interviewing skills during three years of hosting MLB Network's «The Rundown. programme.title: ⋗ MLB Now

programme.title: ⋗ Intentional Talk
programme.desc: Intentional Talk (Sports). MLB Network's first-ever talk show is an open forum that features some talk and a lot of banter each weekday for host Kevin Millar, who discusses with special guests what's hot and what's not in and around the national pastime. He also runs out of the baseline at times by welcoming guests from the worlds of entertainment and pop culture to talk about trending topics in those arenas. Millar gained fame as a member of the 2004 world champion Boston Red Sox, and since he retired from the diamond his knowledge of the game and warm, affable personality have vaulted him into a lengthy career in the media

programme.title: 30 for 30: Brian and the Boz
programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ Get Up
programme.desc: Get Up (Sports). ESPN's morning show features host Mike Greenberg with a rotating and diverse group of analysts opining about and analyzing the latest news from the world of sports. The two-hour, personality-driven show originates from Manhattan's South Street Seaport, a locale that attracts high-profile guests. Greenberg, aka «Greeny,» is formerly one-half of ESPN Radio's longtime «Mike Mike» morning show

programme.title: ⋗ First Take
programme.desc: First Take (Sports). Stephen A. Smith joins host Molly Qerim on this weekday morning sports debate show. Smith provides his expert takes on the day's trending sports topics and under-the-radar news. They're regularly joined by veteran analysts and the top guests in sports and entertainment

programme.title: ⋗ The Pat McAfee Show
programme.desc: The Pat McAfee Show (Sports). Former NFL punter Pat McAfee brings his humor and candor to the microphone to highlight the day's top stories

programme.title: ⋗ NBA Today
programme.desc: NBA Today (Sports). In-depth, comprehensive daily coverage of all aspects of the NBA from expert analysts

programme.title: ⋗ Big Day With Peter Schrager
programme.desc: Big Day With Peter Schrager (Sports)

programme.title: ⋗ NFL Live
programme.desc: NFL Live (Sports). Host Laura Rutledge takes the helm of this weekday show featuring the likes of Marcus Spears, Dan Orlovsky, Mina Kimes, and Adam Schefter. The «NFL Live» crew entertains fans while offering all the latest news and analysis from across the NFL

Other sports reporters appear as guests and offer opinions on the top stories of the day

programme.title: Cyclisme : Championnats du monde sur route
programme.desc: La course en ligne dames se déroule sur une distance de 180,4 km entre Brossard et Montréal, au Canada, pour un parcours exigeant totalisant environ 2500 m de dénivelé positif.

programme.title: Escalade : Coupe du monde
programme.desc: Salt Lake City accueille la 6e et dernière manche de bloc de la saison. Chez les dames, la grimpeuse américaine Annie Sanders, qui a remporté les deux dernières manches en Europe, part favorite sur ses terres. Ses principales adversaires devraient être la Britannique Erin McNeice et l'Australienne Oceana Mackenzie. A suivre également la Française Zélia Avezou, vice-championne d'Europe 2026 de bloc.

programme.title: Athlétisme : Marathon d'Amsterdam
programme.desc: Suivez le Marathon d'Amsterdam, course à pied amateur et professionnelle, une étape du IAAF Road Race Label Events. Le premier marathon d'Amsterdam s'est tenu en 1975. Cette étape figure parmi les plus populaires chez les coureurs professionnels, le parcours étant plat et rapide et propice aux records.

programme.title: Snooker : Open d'Irlande du Nord
programme.desc: L'Open d'Irlande du Nord 2026, faisant partie des Home Nations Series, se déroule au Waterfront Hall de Belfast, marquant la dixième édition de ce tournoi. Les meilleurs joueurs du circuit s'affrontent pour soulever le trophée Alex Higgins. Parmi eux, ce soir, pour le 1er tour : Ali Carter face à Xu Si, Neil Robertson contre Ricky Walden ou encore Shaun Murphy, opposé à Liam Davies.

programme.title: Snooker : Open d'Irlande du Nord
programme.desc: L'Open d'Irlande du Nord de snooker est l'une des quatre manches d'une série de tournois disputés dans les pays du Royaume-Uni, soit en Angleterre, en Irlande du Nord, en Écosse et au Pays de Galles, et composant le Home Nations Series. Si un joueur parvient à remporter les quatre tournois la même année, il empochera un million de livres sterling. La première édition a eu lieu en 2016.

programme.title: Championnats du monde | 5e journée - 2e partie
programme.desc: Au programme de cette 5e journée : keirin femmes, vitesse individuelle hommes, course aux points femmes, élimination hommes et Américaine (Madison) hommes.

programme.title: Snooker : Open d'Irlande du Nord
programme.desc: L'Open d'Irlande du Nord de snooker est l'une des quatre manches d'une série de tournois disputés dans les pays du Royaume-Uni, soit en Angleterre, en Irlande du Nord, en Écosse et au Pays de Galles, et composant le Home Nations Series. programme.title: Snooker : Open d'Irlande du Nord
programme.desc: Ce soir, c'est l'entrée en lice, dans le tournoi, de l'ancien numéro un mondial, l'Anglais Judd Trump. Il affronte son compatriote Martin O'Donnell (n°54). L'an dernier, Trump avait été battu en finale, à Belfast, par Jack Lisowski (9-8). A suivre également Stuart Bingham contre Yao Pengcheng, John Higgins face à Liam Highfield ou encore Zhang Anda, opposé à Liam Pullen.

programme.title: Cyclisme : Championnats du monde sur route
programme.desc: Qui va revêtir le maillot arc-en-ciel et succéder au palmarès au Slovène Tadej Pogacar ? En l'absence de ce dernier, blessé lors du Tour d'Espagne, les favoris pour le titre sont les Belges Remco Evenepoel et Wout van Aert, et le Néerlandais Mathieu van der Poel. Mais une quinzaine de coureurs peuvent également rêver du maillot arc-en-ciel, à l'image du jeune prodige français Paul Seixas, de l'Equatorien Richard Carapaz ou encore de l'Espagnol Isaac Del Toro.

Mais une quinzaine de coureurs peuvent également rêver du maillot arc-en-ciel, à l'image du jeune prodige français Paul Seixas, de l'Equatorien Richard Carapaz ou encore de l'Espagnol Isaac Del Toro.

programme.title: Equitation : Global Champions Tour
programme.desc: Diffusion d'étapes du Global Champions Tour, une compétition internationale de saut d'obstacles réservée aux trente meilleurs cavaliers du classement mondial. La crème du hippisme se réunit lors de ces compétitions de saut d'obstacles qui se déroulent sur les plus réputés terrains de concours hippiques au monde. Créé en 2005, le Global Champions Tour a intégré la FEI sous forme de compétition officielle depuis 2008.

programme.title: ⋗ MLB Central
programme.desc: MLB Central (Sports). MLB Network's first-ever regular-season morning show features hosts Robert Flores, Mark DeRosa and Lauren Shehadi reporting from Studio 21, named in honor of Hall of Famer and humanitarian Roberto Clemente. Updates and context on the latest news, extensive on-field highlights, and long-form conversations with guests, celebrities and insiders from around baseball are presented each weekday morning. Flores joined the network in 2016 as a host/reporter, DeRosa offers a unique outlook as a former player, and Shehadi honed crisp interviewing skills during three years of hosting MLB Network's «The Rundown. programme.title: ⋗ Intentional Talk
programme.desc: Intentional Talk (Sports). MLB Network's first-ever talk show is an open forum that features some talk and a lot of banter each weekday for host Kevin Millar, who discusses with special guests what's hot and what's not in and around the national pastime. He also runs out of the baseline at times by welcoming guests from the worlds of entertainment and pop culture to talk about trending topics in those arenas. Millar gained fame as a member of the 2004 world champion Boston Red Sox, and since he retired from the diamond his knowledge of the game and warm, affable personality have vaulted him into a lengthy career in the media

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

programme.title: CRO Race
programme.desc: Disfruta lo más destacado de las jornadas de competencia en el marco de la Carrera CRO 2026. Siete equipos UCI WorldTeams , diez UCI ProTeams y dos equipos UCI Continental conformaron los 19 equipos que participan en la prueba. Los amantes del deporte podrán disfrutar de una competición que consta de 6 etapas que conectan el interior del territorio con la costa croata.

programme.title: FIFA U17 Women`s WC Morocco 2026

programme.title: UCI Track World Championships
programme.desc: Vive lo más emocionante del Campeonato Mundial de Ciclismo en Pista Tissot UCI 2026. El Campeonato Mundial de Ciclismo en Pista Tissot UCI es el evento anual más importante de la UCI para el ciclismo en pista. En total, se disputan 22 títulos de Campeón Mundial UCI: 11 para hombres y 11 para mujeres.

programme.title: 30 for 30: Brian and the Boz
programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

Other sports reporters appear as guests and offer opinions on the top stories of the day

programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way
